_comment: EXP-000 is the offline framework self-check. It has no hardware and no raw logs; it exists to prove analyze_experiment.py computes correct metrics on fixtures whose answers are known, and that it ERRORS OUT when a required truth category has zero episodes. Copy this directory to experiments/EXP-<id>/ for a real experiment and replace every TODO.
title: framework self-check on fixtures with known answers

hardware.note: EXP-000 is offline: no hardware is used

sampling.note: Primary RQ experiments use a fixed dense 5 s cadence on both nodes

pairing_config.note: max_sample_age is NOT fixed in advance: EXP-004 measures offset/jitter/drift and then sets it

dataset_reuse.note: Reusing a single-node raw dataset for a multi-node conclusion is the F1 error. Read experiment_design.md section 6.1.

n.basis: pilot variance estimate | power calculation | exploratory (state which, or write 'exploratory, no confirmatory claim')

statistics.note: Declare the test BEFORE collecting test data. Never choose it after seeing results.
